verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a scheduling engine under an open-source license is a fair axis for scheduling products, so it applies here. However, the evidence shows only a hosted SaaS with an API, webhooks and embeds. The open-source page lists community contributions such as a Phoenix Inertia.js adapter, which is not the scheduling engine and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
